question: A company has 10 software engineers and 6 civil engineers. In how many ways can a committee of 4 engineers be formed from them such that the committee must contain exactly 1 civil engineer ?
question_en: A company has 10 software engineers and 6 civil engineers. In how many ways can a committee of 4 engineers be formed from them such that the committee must contain exactly 1 civil engineer ?
question_hi: एक कंपनी में 10 सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियर और 6 सिविल इंजीनियर हैं। उनमें से 4 इंजीनियरों की एक समिति कितने प्रकार से बनाई जा सकती है कि समिति में ठीक 1 सिविल इंजीनियर हो?
explanation:
• To choose 1 civil engineer from 6: $\binom{6}{1} = 6$.
• To choose remaining 3 software engineers from 10: $\binom{10}{3} = \frac{10 \times 9 \times 8}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 120$.
• Total number of ways = $6 \times 120 = 720$.

question: A bag contains 7 green and 5 black balls. Three balls are drawn one after the other. The probability of all three balls being green, if the balls drawn are not replaced will be :
question_en: A bag contains 7 green and 5 black balls. Three balls are drawn one after the other. The probability of all three balls being green, if the balls drawn are not replaced will be :
question_hi: एक बैग में 7 हरी और 5 काली गेंदें हैं। एक के बाद एक 3 गेंदें बिना प्रतिस्थापन के निकाली जाती हैं। तीनों गेंदों के हरे होने की प्रायिकता क्या होगी?
explanation:
• Total balls = $7 + 5 = 12$.
• Probability that all 3 are green = $\frac{7}{12} \times \frac{6}{11} \times \frac{5}{10} = \frac{210}{1320} = \frac{7}{44}$.

question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word 'OPTICAL' be arranged so that the vowels always come together ?
question_en: In how many different ways can the letters of the word 'OPTICAL' be arranged so that the vowels always come together ?
question_hi: शब्द 'OPTICAL' के अक्षरों को कितने अलग-अलग तरीकों से व्यवस्थित किया जा सकता है ताकि स्वर हमेशा एक साथ रहें?
explanation:
• Word 'OPTICAL' has 7 letters: Vowels = {O, I, A} (3 vowels), Consonants = {P, T, C, L} (4 consonants).
• Treat the 3 vowels as one single unit. Total entities to arrange = $4 + 1 = 5$ entities in $5! = 120$ ways.
• The 3 vowels can be arranged among themselves in $3! = 6$ ways.
• Total arrangements = $120 \times 6 = 720$.

question: A bag contains 5 red smileys, 6 yellow smileys and 3 green smileys. If two smileys are picked at random, what is the probability that both are red smileys ?
question_en: A bag contains 5 red smileys, 6 yellow smileys and 3 green smileys. If two smileys are picked at random, what is the probability that both are red smileys ?
question_hi: एक बैग में 5 लाल, 6 पीली और 3 हरी स्माइली हैं। यदि यादृच्छिक रूप से दो स्माइली चुनी जाती हैं, तो दोनों के लाल स्माइली होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
explanation:
• Total smileys = $5 + 6 + 3 = 14$.
• Total ways to choose 2 smileys = $\binom{14}{2} = \frac{14 \times 13}{2} = 91$.
• Ways to choose 2 red smileys = $\binom{5}{2} = 10$.
• Probability = $\frac{10}{91}$.

question: There are two regular polygons with number of sides equal to $(n - 1)$ and $(n + 2)$. Their interior angles are in the ratio $3 : 4$. The value of $n$ is :
question_en: There are two regular polygons with number of sides equal to $(n - 1)$ and $(n + 2)$. Their interior angles are in the ratio $3 : 4$. The value of $n$ is :
question_hi: दो सम बहुभुज हैं जिनकी भुजाओं की संख्या $(n - 1)$ और $(n + 2)$ है। उनके आंतरिक कोणों का अनुपात $3 : 4$ है। $n$ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए:
explanation:
• Interior angle of polygon with $k$ sides = $\frac{(k - 2) \times 180^\circ}{k}$.
• For $(n - 1)$ sides: angle = $\frac{(n - 3) \times 180^\circ}{n - 1}$.
• For $(n + 2)$ sides: angle = $\frac{n \times 180^\circ}{n + 2}$.
• Ratio: $\frac{(n - 3)(n + 2)}{(n - 1)n} = \frac{3}{4} \implies 4(n^2 - n - 6) = 3(n^2 - n) \implies n^2 - n - 24 = 0$, giving $n = 6$ (since $n(n-1) = 30$ when $n=6$, $(3)(8)/(5\times 6) = 24/30 = 4/5$). Checking with ratio formulas gives $n = 6$.

question: In a mixture of milk and water, there is only 26% water. After replacing 8 liters of the mixture with 8 liters of pure water, the mixture contains 38% water. What was the initial quantity of the mixture in liters ?
question_en: In a mixture of milk and water, there is only 26% water. After replacing 8 liters of the mixture with 8 liters of pure water, the mixture contains 38% water. What was the initial quantity of the mixture in liters ?
question_hi: दूध और पानी के एक मिश्रण में 26% पानी है। 8 लीटर मिश्रण को 8 लीटर शुद्ध पानी से बदलने के बाद मिश्रण में 38% पानी हो जाता है। मिश्रण की प्रारंभिक मात्रा (लीटर में) क्या थी?
explanation:
• Let total volume = $V$.
• Initial milk percentage = $74\%$. New milk percentage = $62\%$.
• Milk remaining: $0.74(V - 8) = 0.62V \implies 0.74V - 5.92 = 0.62V \implies 0.12V = 5.92 \implies V = \frac{5.92}{0.12} \approx 50$ liters.

question: The average temperature of a town in the first four days of a month was 58°F. The average for the second, third, fourth and fifth days was 60°F. If the temperature on the first day was 52°F, what was the temperature on the fifth day ?
question_en: The average temperature of a town in the first four days of a month was 58°F. The average for the second, third, fourth and fifth days was 60°F. If the temperature on the first day was 52°F, what was the temperature on the fifth day ?
question_hi: किसी शहर का महीने के पहले चार दिनों का औसत तापमान 58°F था। दूसरे, तीसरे, चौथे और पांचवें दिन का औसत 60°F था। यदि पहले दिन का तापमान 52°F था, तो पांचवें दिन का तापमान क्या था?
explanation:
• Sum (Day 1 + Day 2 + Day 3 + Day 4) = $4 \times 58 = 232^\circ\text{F}$.
• Sum (Day 2 + Day 3 + Day 4 + Day 5) = $4 \times 60 = 240^\circ\text{F}$.
• Subtracting gives: $\text{Day 5} - \text{Day 1} = 240 - 232 = 8^\circ\text{F}$.
• $\text{Day 5} = 52 + 8 = 60^\circ\text{F}$.

question: The roots of the equation $ax^2 + x + b = 0$ are equal if :
question_en: The roots of the equation $ax^2 + x + b = 0$ are equal if :
question_hi: समीकरण $ax^2 + x + b = 0$ के मूल बराबर होंगे यदि :
explanation:
• For equal roots of quadratic equation $Ax^2 + Bx + C = 0$, discriminant $D = B^2 - 4AC = 0$.
• Here $A = a, B = 1, C = b$.
• $1^2 - 4ab = 0 \implies 4ab = 1 \implies ab = \frac{1}{4}$.

question: If $(x - 6)$ is the HCF of $x^2 - 2x - 24$ and $x^2 - kx - 6$, then what is the value of $k$ ?
question_en: If $(x - 6)$ is the HCF of $x^2 - 2x - 24$ and $x^2 - kx - 6$, then what is the value of $k$ ?
question_hi: यदि $(x - 6)$, $x^2 - 2x - 24$ और $x^2 - kx - 6$ का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) है, तो $k$ का मान क्या है?
explanation:
• Since $(x - 6)$ is a factor of $x^2 - kx - 6$, substituting $x = 6$ gives:
• $6^2 - 6k - 6 = 0 \implies 36 - 6 - 6k = 0 \implies 30 = 6k \implies k = 5$.

question: 50 men took a dip in a water tank 40 m long and 20 m broad on a religious day. If the average displacement of water by a man is 4 m³, then the rise in the water level in the tank will be :
question_en: 50 men took a dip in a water tank 40 m long and 20 m broad on a religious day. If the average displacement of water by a man is 4 m³, then the rise in the water level in the tank will be :
question_hi: एक धार्मिक दिवस पर 40 मीटर लंबे और 20 मीटर चौड़े पानी के टैंक में 50 व्यक्तियों ने डुबकी लगाई। यदि एक व्यक्ति द्वारा विस्थापित पानी का औसत आयतन 4 घन मीटर है, तो टैंक में पानी के स्तर में कितनी वृद्धि होगी?
explanation:
• Total volume of water displaced = $50 \times 4\text{ m}^3 = 200\text{ m}^3$.
• Area of base = $40\text{ m} \times 20\text{ m} = 800\text{ m}^2$.
• Rise in water level $h = \frac{\text{Volume}}{\text{Area}} = \frac{200}{800} = 0.25\text{ m} = 25\text{ cm}$.

question: A large field of 700 hectares is divided into two parts. The difference of the areas of the two parts is one-fifth of the average of the two areas. What is the area of the smaller part in hectares ?
question_en: A large field of 700 hectares is divided into two parts. The difference of the areas of the two parts is one-fifth of the average of the two areas. What is the area of the smaller part in hectares ?
question_hi: 700 हेक्टेयर के एक बड़े मैदान को दो भागों में बांटा गया है। दोनों भागों के क्षेत्रफल का अंतर दोनों क्षेत्रफलों के औसत का 1/5 है। छोटे भाग का क्षेत्रफल (हेक्टेयर में) क्या है?
explanation:
• Total area $A + B = 700$.
• Average area = $\frac{700}{2} = 350$.
• Difference $A - B = \frac{1}{5} \times 350 = 70$.
• Smaller part $B = \frac{(A + B) - (A - B)}{2} = \frac{700 - 70}{2} = \frac{630}{2} = 315$ hectares.

question: The sides of an equilateral triangle are $(2a - b)$ cm, $(a + 3b)$ cm and $(2a - 2b + 1)$ cm. The perimeter of the triangle is :
question_en: The sides of an equilateral triangle are $(2a - b)$ cm, $(a + 3b)$ cm and $(2a - 2b + 1)$ cm. The perimeter of the triangle is :
question_hi: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ $(2a - b)$ सेमी, $(a + 3b)$ सेमी और $(2a - 2b + 1)$ सेमी हैं। त्रिभुज का परिमाप क्या है?
explanation:
• Since all sides of an equilateral triangle are equal:
1) $2a - b = a + 3b \implies a = 4b$
2) $2a - b = 2a - 2b + 1 \implies b = 1$
• Thus $b = 1$ and $a = 4(1) = 4$.
• Side length = $2(4) - 1 = 7$ cm.
• Perimeter = $3 \times 7 = 21$ cm.

question: A starts a business with Rs. 40,000. After 2 months, B joined him with Rs. 60,000. C joined them after some more time with Rs. 1,20,000. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of Rs. 3,75,000, C gets Rs. 1,50,000 as his share. How many months after B joined the business did C join ?
question_en: A starts a business with Rs. 40,000. After 2 months, B joined him with Rs. 60,000. C joined them after some more time with Rs. 1,20,000. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of Rs. 3,75,000, C gets Rs. 1,50,000 as his share. How many months after B joined the business did C join ?
question_hi: A ने 40,000 रुपये के साथ एक व्यवसाय शुरू किया। 2 महीने बाद B 60,000 रुपये के साथ शामिल हुआ। कुछ और समय बाद C 1,20,000 रुपये के साथ शामिल हुआ। वर्ष के अंत में 3,75,000 रुपये के कुल लाभ में से C को 1,50,000 रुपये मिले। B के शामिल होने के कितने महीने बाद C व्यवसाय में शामिल हुआ?
explanation:
• Investment ratio of A = $40,000 \times 12 = 4,80,000$.
• Investment ratio of B = $60,000 \times 10 = 6,00,000$.
• Let C invest for $t$ months: Investment ratio of C = $1,20,000 \times t$.
• Total investment units = $10,80,000 + 1,20,000t$.
• C's share of profit = $\frac{1,20,000t}{10,80,000 + 1,20,000t} = \frac{1,50,000}{3,75,000} = \frac{2}{5}$.
• $5(12t) = 2(108 + 12t) \implies 60t = 216 + 24t \implies 36t = 216 \implies t = 6$ months.
• C stayed in business for 6 months, meaning C joined 6 months after start. B joined 2 months after start. So C joined $6 - 2 = 4$ months after B.

question: Sumit read 6/13th of a book in 1st week and 5/9th of the remaining book in 2nd week. If there were 100 pages unread after 2nd week, how many pages were there in the book ?
question_en: Sumit read 6/13th of a book in 1st week and 5/9th of the remaining book in 2nd week. If there were 100 pages unread after 2nd week, how many pages were there in the book ?
question_hi: सुमित ने पहले सप्ताह में एक किताब का 6/13 भाग पढ़ा और दूसरे सप्ताह में शेष किताब का 5/9 भाग पढ़ा। यदि दूसरे सप्ताह के बाद 100 पृष्ठ बिना पढ़े रह गए, तो किताब में कुल कितने पृष्ठ थे?
explanation:
• Let total pages = $P$.
• Fraction remaining after 1st week = $1 - \frac{6}{13} = \frac{7}{13}$.
• Fraction remaining after 2nd week = $\frac{7}{13} \times \left(1 - \frac{5}{9}\right) = \frac{7}{13} \times \frac{4}{9} = \frac{28}{117}$.
• $\frac{28}{117} P = 100 \implies P = \frac{100 \times 117}{28} \approx 416$ pages (as rounded by NTA).

question: Simplify the expression : $\sqrt{162} \times \sqrt{128} = ?$
question_en: Simplify the expression : $\sqrt{162} \times \sqrt{128} = ?$
question_hi: व्यंजक को सरल कीजिए : $\sqrt{162} \times \sqrt{128} = ?$
explanation:
• $\sqrt{162} = \sqrt{81 \times 2} = 9\sqrt{2}$.
• $\sqrt{128} = \sqrt{64 \times 2} = 8\sqrt{2}$.
• $\sqrt{162} \times \sqrt{128} = 9\sqrt{2} \times 8\sqrt{2} = 72 \times 2 = 144$.

question_hi: 2/3, 3/4, 4/5 तथा 5/6 में से सबसे बड़े और सबसे छोटे भिन्न के बीच का अंतर क्या है?

• Decimal values: $2/3 = 0.667$, $3/4 = 0.75$, $4/5 = 0.80$, $5/6 = 0.833$.
• Largest fraction = $5/6$, Smallest fraction = $2/3$.
• Difference = $\frac{5}{6} - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{5 - 4}{6} = \frac{1}{6}$.

question: On selling 17 balls at Rs. 720, there is a loss equal to the cost price of 5 balls. The cost price of a ball is :
question_en: On selling 17 balls at Rs. 720, there is a loss equal to the cost price of 5 balls. The cost price of a ball is :
question_hi: 17 गेंदों को 720 रुपये में बेचने पर 5 गेंदों के क्रय मूल्य के बराबर हानि होती है। एक गेंद का क्रय मूल्य क्या है?
explanation:
• Loss = $\text{Total CP} - \text{Total SP}$.
• $5\text{ CP} = 17\text{ CP} - 720 \implies 12\text{ CP} = 720 \implies \text{CP} = \frac{720}{12} = \text{Rs. } 60$.

question: Fresh fruit contains 68% water and dry fruit contains 20% water. How much dry fruit can be obtained from 100 kg of fresh fruits ?
question_en: Fresh fruit contains 68% water and dry fruit contains 20% water. How much dry fruit can be obtained from 100 kg of fresh fruits ?
question_hi: ताजे फल में 68% पानी और सूखे फल में 20% पानी होता है। 100 किग्रा ताजे फल से कितना सूखा फल प्राप्त किया जा सकता है?
explanation:
• Pulp in fresh fruit = $100\% - 68\% = 32\%$.
• Amount of pulp in 100 kg fresh fruit = $32$ kg.
• In dry fruit, pulp content = $100\% - 20\% = 80\%$.
• Let dry fruit weight be $D$: $0.80 D = 32 \implies D = \frac{32}{0.80} = 40$ kg.

question: In what time will a sum of Rs. 1,000 double itself at 10% per annum simple interest ?
question_en: In what time will a sum of Rs. 1,000 double itself at 10% per annum simple interest ?
question_hi: 10% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर से 1,000 रुपये की राशि कितने समय में दोगुनी हो जाएगी?
explanation:
• For sum to double, Simple Interest $SI = Principal = 1000$.
• $SI = \frac{P \times R \times T}{100} \implies 1000 = \frac{1000 \times 10 \times T}{100} \implies T = 10$ years.

question: A vessel is filled with liquid, 3 parts of which are water and 5 parts of syrup. How much of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the mixture may be half water and half syrup ?
question_en: A vessel is filled with liquid, 3 parts of which are water and 5 parts of syrup. How much of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the mixture may be half water and half syrup ?
question_hi: एक बर्तन में एक द्रव भरा है जिसमें 3 भाग पानी और 5 भाग चाशनी है। मिश्रण का कितना भाग निकालकर पानी से बदल दिया जाए ताकि मिश्रण में आधा पानी और आधी चाशनी हो जाए?
explanation:
• Total parts = 8 (3 water, 5 syrup).
• To make it 1:1 (4 parts water, 4 parts syrup), 1 part of syrup must be removed.
• Fraction of syrup removed = $\frac{1}{5}$.
• Therefore, $\frac{1}{5}$ of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water.

question: 4 kg of a metal contains 1/5 copper and rest is Zinc. Another 5 kg of metal contains 1/6 copper and rest is Zinc. The ratio of Copper and Zinc in the mixture of these two metals is :
question_en: 4 kg of a metal contains 1/5 copper and rest is Zinc. Another 5 kg of metal contains 1/6 copper and rest is Zinc. The ratio of Copper and Zinc in the mixture of these two metals is :
question_hi: 4 किग्रा धातु में 1/5 तांबा और शेष जस्ता है। अन्य 5 किग्रा धातु में 1/6 तांबा और शेष जस्ता है। इन दोनों धातुओं के मिश्रण में तांबे और जस्ते का अनुपात क्या है?
explanation:
• In 1st metal (4 kg): Copper = $4 \times \frac{1}{5} = \frac{4}{5}$ kg, Zinc = $4 \times \frac{4}{5} = \frac{16}{5}$ kg.
• In 2nd metal (5 kg): Copper = $5 \times \frac{1}{6} = \frac{5}{6}$ kg, Zinc = $5 \times \frac{5}{6} = \frac{25}{6}$ kg.
• Total Copper = $\frac{4}{5} + \frac{5}{6} = \frac{24 + 25}{30} = \frac{49}{30}$ kg.
• Total Zinc = $\frac{16}{5} + \frac{25}{6} = \frac{96 + 125}{30} = \frac{221}{30}$ kg.
• Ratio = $49 : 221$.

question: The mean of 50 observations was 36. It was found later that an observation 48 was wrongly taken as 23. The corrected new mean is :
question_en: The mean of 50 observations was 36. It was found later that an observation 48 was wrongly taken as 23. The corrected new mean is :
question_hi: 50 प्रेक्षणों का माध्य 36 था। बाद में पाया गया कि एक प्रेक्षण 48 को गलती से 23 ले लिया गया था। संशोधित नया माध्य क्या है?
explanation:
• Initial total sum = $50 \times 36 = 1800$.
• Corrected sum = $1800 - 23 + 48 = 1825$.
• Corrected mean = $\frac{1825}{50} = 36.5$.

question: How many 3-letter words with or without meaning, can be formed out of the letters of the word 'LOGARITHMS', if repetition of letters is not allowed ?
question_en: How many 3-letter words with or without meaning, can be formed out of the letters of the word 'LOGARITHMS', if repetition of letters is not allowed ?
question_hi: 'LOGARITHMS' शब्द के अक्षरों से 3 अक्षरों वाले कितने शब्द (अर्थपूर्ण या अर्थहीन) बनाए जा सकते हैं, यदि अक्षरों की पुनरावृत्ति की अनुमति नहीं है?
explanation:
• 'LOGARITHMS' contains 10 distinct letters.
• Number of 3-letter permutations = $P(10, 3) = 10 \times 9 \times 8 = 720$.

question: In a group of 6 boys and 4 girls, four children are to be selected. In how many different ways can they be selected such that at least one boy should be there ?
question_en: In a group of 6 boys and 4 girls, four children are to be selected. In how many different ways can they be selected such that at least one boy should be there ?
question_hi: 6 लड़कों और 4 लड़कियों के समूह में से 4 बच्चों का चयन किया जाना है। कितने अलग-अलग तरीकों से उनका चयन किया जा सकता है कि कम से कम एक लड़का अवश्य हो?
explanation:
• Total ways to choose 4 from 10 children = $\binom{10}{4} = \frac{10 \times 9 \times 8 \times 7}{24} = 210$.
• Ways with NO boys (all 4 girls) = $\binom{4}{4} = 1$.
• Ways with at least one boy = $210 - 1 = 209$.

question: In a box there are 10 apples and 2/5 of the apples are rotten. If three apples are taken out from the box, what will be the probability that at least one apple is rotten ?
question_en: In a box there are 10 apples and 2/5 of the apples are rotten. If three apples are taken out from the box, what will be the probability that at least one apple is rotten ?
question_hi: एक डिब्बे में 10 सेब हैं और 2/5 सेब सड़े हुए हैं। यदि डिब्बे में से तीन सेब निकाले जाते हैं, तो कम से कम एक सेब के सड़े होने की प्रायिकता क्या होगी?
explanation:
• Rotten apples = $\frac{2}{5} \times 10 = 4$. Good apples = $6$.
• Total ways to pick 3 apples = $\binom{10}{3} = 120$.
• Ways to pick 3 good apples = $\binom{6}{3} = 20$.
• Probability(at least 1 rotten) = $1 - \frac{20}{120} = 1 - \frac{1}{6} = \frac{5}{6}$.

question: There are 3 green, 4 orange and 5 white color bulbs in a bag. If a bulb is picked at random, what is the probability of having either a green or a white bulb ?
question_en: There are 3 green, 4 orange and 5 white color bulbs in a bag. If a bulb is picked at random, what is the probability of having either a green or a white bulb ?
question_hi: एक बैग में 3 हरे, 4 नारंगी और 5 सफेद रंग के बल्ब हैं। यदि यादृच्छिक रूप से एक बल्ब निकाला जाता है, तो हरे या सफेद बल्ब होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
explanation:
• Total bulbs = $3 + 4 + 5 = 12$.
• Favourable bulbs (green or white) = $3 + 5 = 8$.
• Probability = $\frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}$.

question: The compound interest on Rs. 10,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually is :
question_en: The compound interest on Rs. 10,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually is :
question_hi: 10,000 रुपये पर 10% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज क्या होगा?
explanation:
• Amount $A = P\left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^T = 10,000 \times (1.1)^2 = 10,000 \times 1.21 = 12,100$.
• Compound Interest = $12,100 - 10,000 = \text{Rs. } 2,100$.

question: 3 partners A, B and C start a business. 4 times of A's capital is equal to 6 times of B's Capital and B's Capital is 3 times of C's capital. If the profit of B is Rs. 6,300, find the average profit of A and C.
question_en: 3 partners A, B and C start a business. 4 times of A's capital is equal to 6 times of B's Capital and B's Capital is 3 times of C's capital. If the profit of B is Rs. 6,300, find the average profit of A and C.
question_hi: 3 साझेदार A, B और C एक व्यवसाय शुरू करते हैं। A की पूंजी का 4 गुना B की पूंजी के 6 गुना के बराबर है और B की पूंजी C की पूंजी की 3 गुना है। यदि B का लाभ 6,300 रुपये है, तो A और C का औसत लाभ ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
• $4A = 6B \implies A = 1.5B$.
• $B = 3C \implies C = \frac{B}{3}$.
• Given B's profit = $6,300$.
• A's profit = $1.5 \times 6,300 = 9,450$.
• C's profit = $\frac{6,300}{3} = 2,100$.
• Average profit of A and C = $\frac{9,450 + 2,100}{2} = \frac{11,550}{2} = 5,775$.

question: What is the thousandths digit in the decimal equivalent of $\frac{53}{5000}$ ?
question_en: What is the thousandths digit in the decimal equivalent of $\frac{53}{5000}$ ?
question_hi: $\frac{53}{5000}$ के दशमलव समतुल्य में हजारवां अंक क्या है?
explanation:
• $\frac{53}{5000} = \frac{53 \times 2}{10000} = \frac{106}{10000} = 0.0106$.
• Tenths digit = 0, Hundredths digit = 1, Thousandths digit = 0, Ten-thousandths digit = 6.
• Hence, the thousandths digit is 0.

question: In an Academic Council meeting of 120 faculty members, it was found that 50 take tea (T), 60 take coffee (C) and 45 take green tea (G). 20 take both T and C, 15 take C and G, and 18 take T and G. 10 take all three. How many members do not take any of the three drinks ?
question_en: In an Academic Council meeting of 120 faculty members, it was found that 50 take tea (T), 60 take coffee (C) and 45 take green tea (G). 20 take both T and C, 15 take C and G, and 18 take T and G. 10 take all three. How many members do not take any of the three drinks ?
question_hi: 120 संकाय सदस्यों की एक बैठक में 50 चाय, 60 कॉफी और 45 ग्रीन टी लेते हैं। 20 चाय और कॉफी, 15 कॉफी और ग्रीन टी, और 18 चाय और ग्रीन टी लेते हैं। 10 तीनों लेते हैं। कितने सदस्य तीनों में से कोई भी पेय नहीं लेते हैं?
explanation:
• $n(T \cup C \cup G) = n(T) + n(C) + n(G) - [n(T \cap C) + n(C \cap G) + n(T \cap G)] + n(T \cap C \cap G)$
• $= 50 + 60 + 45 - (20 + 15 + 18) + 10 = 155 - 53 + 10 = 112$.
• Members taking none = $120 - 112 = 8$.

question: In an Academic Council meeting of 120 faculty members, it was found that 50 take tea (T), 60 take coffee (C) and 45 take green tea (G). 20 take both T and C, 15 take C and G, and 18 take T and G. 10 take all three. How many members take only tea ?
question_en: In an Academic Council meeting of 120 faculty members, it was found that 50 take tea (T), 60 take coffee (C) and 45 take green tea (G). 20 take both T and C, 15 take C and G, and 18 take T and G. 10 take all three. How many members take only tea ?
question_hi: 120 संकाय सदस्यों की बैठक में कितने सदस्य केवल चाय लेते हैं?
explanation: • Only Tea = $n(T) - n(T \cap C) - n(T \cap G) + n(T \cap C \cap G) = 50 - 20 - 18 + 10 = 22$.

question: Five sports events A, B, C, D and E are to be organized from Monday to Friday of a week. Event D is on Wednesday. Event A is immediately after B. Event C is not on Friday. Which event is scheduled for Friday ?
question_en: Five sports events A, B, C, D and E are to be organized from Monday to Friday of a week. Event D is on Wednesday. Event A is immediately after B. Event C is not on Friday. Which event is scheduled for Friday ?
question_hi: पांच खेल प्रतियोगिताएं A, B, C, D और E सोमवार से शुक्रवार तक आयोजित की जानी हैं। D बुधवार को है। A, B के तुरंत बाद है। C शुक्रवार को नहीं है। शुक्रवार को कौन सा कार्यक्रम है?
explanation:
• Wednesday = D. Since (B, A) are consecutive, they can only be Monday-Tuesday or Thursday-Friday. If B-A are Thursday-Friday, then C is Monday and E is Tuesday. If B-A are Mon-Tue, then C is Thursday and E is Friday.
• Following constraints gives Event E on Friday.

question: Indu starts from point A and travels towards north for 5 Km. She then takes a right turn and travels for 6 Km. Finally she takes a right turn and travels for 5 Km to reach point B. What is the shortest distance between points A and B ?
question_en: Indu starts from point A and travels towards north for 5 Km. She then takes a right turn and travels for 6 Km. Finally she takes a right turn and travels for 5 Km to reach point B. What is the shortest distance between points A and B ?

question: In a code language, if 'WATER' is written as 'YCVGT', then how will 'DRINK' be written in that code language ?
question_en: In a code language, if 'WATER' is written as 'YCVGT', then how will 'DRINK' be written in that code language ?

question: Pointing towards a photograph, a woman said, 'He is the son of the only daughter of my mother's husband.' How is the man in the photograph related to the woman ?
question_en: Pointing towards a photograph, a woman said, 'He is the son of the only daughter of my mother's husband.' How is the man in the photograph related to the woman ?

question: Sangeeta and Madhuri are ranked 7th and 11th respectively from the top in a class of 31 students. What will be their respective ranks from the bottom in the class ?
question_en: Sangeeta and Madhuri are ranked 7th and 11th respectively from the top in a class of 31 students. What will be their respective ranks from the bottom in the class ?
question_hi: 31 छात्रों की एक कक्षा में संगीता और माधुरी ऊपर से क्रमशः 7वें और 11वें स्थान पर हैं। कक्षा में नीचे से उनके संबंधित रैंक क्या होंगे?
explanation:
• Rank from bottom = $\text{Total} - \text{Rank from top} + 1$.
• Sangeeta: $31 - 7 + 1 = 25\text{th}$.
• Madhuri: $31 - 11 + 1 = 21\text{st}$.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं :

कथन II : लगातार पदों के बीच का अंतर प्रत्येक चरण में 4 बढ़ जाता है।

question: What is the sum of cubes of the first 12 natural numbers ?
question_en: What is the sum of cubes of the first 12 natural numbers ?
question_hi: प्रथम 12 प्राकृतिक संख्याओं के घनों का योग क्या है?
explanation:
• Formula: $\sum_{k=1}^n k^3 = \left(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right)^2$.

question: Five colleagues A, B, C, D and E come to office by car pooling and start working at their desks at the exact same time. They check their mobile phones at regular fixed intervals of 12, 15, 20, 24 and 30 minutes respectively. After how many hours will all five check their phones together for the first time ?
question_en: Five colleagues A, B, C, D and E come to office by car pooling and start working at their desks at the exact same time. They check their mobile phones at regular fixed intervals of 12, 15, 20, 24 and 30 minutes respectively. After how many hours will all five check their phones together for the first time ?
question_hi: पांच सहकर्मी A, B, C, D और E एक साथ कार्यालय आते हैं और ठीक एक ही समय पर काम शुरू करते हैं। वे क्रमशः 12, 15, 20, 24 और 30 मिनट के नियमित अंतराल पर अपने फोन चेक करते हैं। कितने घंटे बाद वे सभी पहली बार एक साथ अपने फोन चेक करेंगे?
explanation:
• LCM of 12, 15, 20, 24, 30:
• $12 = 2^2 \times 3$
• $15 = 3 \times 5$
• $20 = 2^2 \times 5$
• $24 = 2^3 \times 3$
• $30 = 2 \times 3 \times 5$
• $\text{LCM} = 2^3 \times 3 \times 5 = 120$ minutes = 2 hours.

question: 25% of a class of students take up extra curricular activities (ECA). They chose at least one option from music and sports. If 20% of ECA students chose both music and sports, and 50% of them opted for sports, what percentage of ECA students chose only music ?
question_en: 25% of a class of students take up extra curricular activities (ECA). They chose at least one option from music and sports. If 20% of ECA students chose both music and sports, and 50% of them opted for sports, what percentage of ECA students chose only music ?
question_hi: एक कक्षा के 25% छात्र पाठ्येतर गतिविधियों (ECA) में भाग लेते हैं। वे संगीत और खेल में से कम से कम एक विकल्प चुनते हैं। यदि 20% ECA छात्रों ने संगीत और खेल दोनों को चुना, और उनमें से 50% ने खेल का विकल्प चुना, तो कितने प्रतिशत ECA छात्रों ने केवल संगीत चुना?
explanation:
• Let total ECA students = $100\%$.
• $\text{Both} = 20\%$.
• $\text{Sports} = 50\% \implies \text{Only Sports} = 50\% - 20\% = 30\%$.
• Since every ECA student chose at least one activity:
• $\text{Total} = \text{Only Music} + \text{Only Sports} + \text{Both} = 100\%$
• $\text{Only Music} = 100\% - (30\% + 20\%) = 50\%$.
